## Reproducibility

1. **Peng RD.** [Reproducible research in computational science](https://doi.org/10.1126/science.1213847).
   *Science* 2011;334:1226–7. Introduces the reproducibility
   spectrum (from "publication only" to "full replication").

2. **Baker M.** [1,500 scientists lift the lid on reproducibility](https://doi.org/10.1038/533452a).
   *Nature* 2016;533:452–4. The survey where most researchers reported
   failing to reproduce someone else's experiment, and more than half failed
   to reproduce their own.


## Learning with data
 
- **Wickham H, Cetinkaya-Rundel M, Grolemund G** [R for Data Science](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/).
  *O'Reilly* June 2025. The practical guide that teaches how to use R and the tidyverse to import, transform, visualize, and understand data.

- **Wickham H.** [Tidy data](https://doi.org/10.18637/jss.v059.i10).
  *Journal of Statistical Software* 2014;59(10). The one-sentence version:
  each variable a column, each observation a row, each type of observational
  unit a table. Everything `dplyr` does on Day 1 afternoon assumes it.

## Generative AI in research


- **IBM** [What is generative AI?](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/generative-ai).
  The resource provides a comprehensive overview of generative AI, explaining how it works, its applications and benefits, and its key challenges and risks.

- **WHO.** [Ethics and governance of artificial intelligence for health: guidance on large multi-modal models](https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240084759). 2025. Skim the governance section.

- **NITI Aayog.** [National Strategy for Artificial Intelligence](https://www.niti.gov.in/national-strategy-artificial-intelligence).
  Context for the "AI ecosystem in India".


## A note on how to read all this

You are not expected to absorb it. Skim now, and come back after the
workshop when the words have referents. The single most useful thing you can
do before 9 September is finish [the R primer](r-primer.qmd): a concept you
have typed once beats a concept you have read three times.
